rules.title: How It Works
rules.subtitle: Everything you need to know to play Trixer.
rules.s1p1: Trixer is an athlete market game based on real triathlon races (Full and Middle Distance). You start with a T$200 wallet, buy athletes on the market, and watch your roster's value rise or fall based on race results.
rules.s1p2: It's not just about picking a team — it's about buying at the right time, selling before an athlete's value drops, and building the best roster for the next race.
rules.s1example: You buy Kristian Blummenfelt for T$35. He wins IRONMAN Texas. His value rises to T$40. If you sell now, you pocket T$40 — a T$5 profit. Or hold for the next race.
rules.s2p1: Every account starts with T$200 in Trix Coins (T$). That's your budget to buy athletes on the market.
rules.s2li1: Buy: the athlete's price is debited from your wallet and they join your roster.
rules.s2li2: Sell: the athlete's current price is credited to your wallet and they leave your roster.
rules.s2li3: No athlete limit — only your balance limits you.
rules.s2example: Wallet: T$200. You buy 3 athletes: T$35 + T$28 + T$18 = T$81 spent. Wallet drops to T$119. Roster worth T$81. Total net worth stays T$200 — no gain yet.
rules.s3p1: In the market you see all athletes with their current price and movement. Base prices follow the global PTO ranking:
rules.s3p2: After each race, prices are updated:
rules.s3example: Marta Sánchez was worth T$18. She finished 3rd at IRONMAN Texas → price rose to T$20. If you bought before the race and sold after, you made T$2 profit per athlete.
rules.s4Title: Market Window — When Can I Buy and Sell?
rules.s4p1: The market closes 24 hours before any race. It reopens only when the results of that race are published.
rules.s4openDesc: More than 24h until the next race. Buy and sell freely.
rules.s4lockedDesc: Less than 24h to the race or race in progress. No transactions.
rules.s4warning: ⚠ Note: athletes who DNS (do not start) have their price reduced. Follow pre-race news — if your athlete withdrew, you have up to 24h before the race to sell.
rules.s4example: IRONMAN South Africa is on Saturday. The market closes Friday at midnight UTC. After results are published, the market reopens and you can rebalance your roster for the next race.
rules.s5Title: Picking a Team for a Race
rules.s5p1: For each open race, you pick 5 athletes from your roster who are registered for that race. Picking is free — you just need to own the athletes.
rules.s5li1: You can only pick athletes you have bought on the market.
rules.s5li2: Men and women can be on the same team — no gender restrictions.
rules.s5li3: Your team can be changed until the market closes (24h before the race).
rules.s5li4: You only have one team per race.
rules.s5example: Your roster includes: Blummenfelt (M), Van Riel (M), Løvseth (F), Knibb (F), Marta Sánchez (F). They're all in IRONMAN Texas. You pick them → Trix Score calculated after the race.
rules.s6p1: Scoring is calculated by position in the PRO field.
rules.s7p1: Create a private league and invite friends to compete on who builds the best team for a specific race.
rules.s7li2: Ranked by Trix Score — whoever has the most points in their picked team wins.
rules.s7li3: Join multiple leagues with the same team.
rules.s7example: You and 5 friends create a league for IRONMAN 70.3 Brasília. Each picks 5 athletes. After the race, the system shows the ranking.
rules.s8li1: Buy before races: athletes who perform well rise in price. Buy early, sell after.
rules.s8li2: Watch for DNS: if a favourite withdrew, sell before the market closes.
rules.s8li3: Diversify: a mix of men and women across different races can score more points.
rules.s8li4: Value picks: athletes without a PTO ranking cost T$10 — if they perform well, the return can be surprising.
rules.s8li5: Net worth = wallet + roster: track P&L for each athlete in My Roster.
rules.s9li1: Trixer is a recreational game — no cash prizes.
rules.s9li2: We are not affiliated with Ironman/WTC or any triathlon organisation.
rules.s9li3: Results are entered manually — there may be a delay after the race.
rules.s9li4: Rules and prices may be adjusted by the admin before a race starts.
